mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, device_uuid, device_name, platform, enabled, v2ray_uuid, last_ip, last_seen_at, created_at FROM vpn_device WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND device_uuid = #{deviceUuid} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, device_uuid, device_name, platform, enabled, v2ray_uuid, last_ip, last_seen_at, created_at FROM vpn_device WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vpn_device (user_id, device_uuid, device_name, platform, enabled, v2ray_uuid, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceUuid}, #{deviceName}, #{platform}, 1, #{v2rayUuid}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE vpn_device SET last_ip = #{lastIp}, last_seen_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE vpn_device SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vpn_device WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT d.id, d.user_id AS userId, u.email, d.device_uuid AS deviceUuid, d.device_name AS deviceName, d.platform, d.enabled, d.last_ip AS lastIp, d.last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt, CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'online' ELSE 'offline' END AS onlineStatus FROM vpn_device d JOIN vpn_user u ON u.id = d.user_id LEFT JOIN vpn_session s ON s.device_id = d.id AND s.status = 'online'
AND d.user_id = #{userId}
AND (u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR d.device_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR d.device_uuid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))
ORDER BY d.id DESC
